'''Orten Theb''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] living in [[New Adasta]] on [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3636 BBY]] the former Sith Emperor [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]] came to the world and possessed many of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperials]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], turning them into his puppets to [[Death/Legends|murder]] civilians. Orten Theb was among those who was killed during the fighting.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Orten Theb was added to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' in game update 3.2.
